reviewDescription: Okay, hijacking my husbands account! This is Klisha and I woke up yesterday with sinus pressure on my left side, congestion and a sinus headache. I don't think I even inhaled for more than 2 minutes before my nose started dripping and the pressure was released. I really love these. I've had sinus pressure so often. These will be my go to! Thank you!P.s. You can use half of a tablet for quick showers!
